title: The BBC Convinced Britain That Spaghetti Grows On Trees 🍝
caption:
The BBC told Britain that spaghetti grows on trees 🍝
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. On 1 April 1957 the BBC show Panorama ran a short report on a Swiss family harvesting their spaghetti crop, narrated by the trusted presenter Richard Dimbleby. Hundreds of viewers phoned in to ask how to grow their own. It was an April Fools joke.
Would you have believed it? 👇
first_comment: Pasta was still exotic in Britain back then. Would you have believed it? 🍝👇
